source.name: Capital Sport (capitalfm.co.ke): Nairobi City Thunder Name Send App as Main Sponsor Ahead of Saturday Season Opener
source.quote: Send App, a cross-border remittance and payments platform by Flutterwave, as the club’s front-of-shirt sponsor on a two-season deal, starting with the 2026 campaign

note: Two-season front-of-shirt deal beginning with the 2026 campaign; no deal value reported.
